about_short_description.short_description: SuperTokens offers an open source authentication - as an alternative to Auth0, Okta, Firebase Auth and AWS Cognito

product.name: SuperTokens Open Source Authentication Core
product.description: An open source authentication system providing session management, user login, and security features for developers to integrate into applications.

product.name: SuperTokens Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
product.description: A multi-factor authentication service that adds additional verification layers like OTPs and TOTP to enhance account security.

product.name: SuperTokens Social Login Integration
product.description: A feature enabling user authentication via third-party social providers like GitHub, Google, and Facebook.

product.name: SuperTokens Session Management
product.description: A system for managing user sessions with features like token refresh, session revocation, and secure cookie handling.

product.name: SuperTokens Self-Hosting Deployment
product.description: An option to deploy the SuperTokens authentication system on a customer’s own infrastructure for greater control and compliance.
